scripts.types: bunx --bun --no-install civet --emit-declaration src/client.ts src/server.ts src/database.ts src/capabilities.ts src/server/capabilities.ts src/server/capabilities-loader.ts src/server/capability-readiness.ts
scripts.typecheck: bunx --bun --no-install civet --typecheck src/client.ts src/server.ts src/database.ts src/capabilities.ts src/server/capabilities.ts src/server/capabilities-loader.ts src/server/capability-readiness.ts src/*.test.ts
scripts.test: bun run types && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit src/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun run types && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit .
